import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static class ModInt {
        static int MOD;
        int value;

        ModInt(long x) {
            value = (int)((x % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            return new ModInt((long)this.value + other.value);
        }

        ModInt sub(ModInt other) {
            return new ModInt((long)this.value - other.value);
        }

        ModInt mul(ModInt other) {
            return new ModInt((long)this.value * other.value);
        }

        ModInt div(ModInt other) {
            return this.mul(other.inv());
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(inv(this.value, MOD));
        }

        static long inv(long a, long mod) {
            long u = 0, v = 1;
            long m = mod;
            while (a != 0) {
                long t = m / a;
                m -= t * a;
                long temp = a; a = m; m = temp;
                u -= t * v;
                temp = u; u = v; v = temp;
            }
            u %= mod;
            if (u < 0) u += mod;
            return u;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(value);
        }
    }

    static ModInt[] fact, invFact;

    static void precomputeFactorials(int max) {
        fact = new ModInt[max + 1];
        invFact = new ModInt[max + 1];
        fact[0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= max; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1].mul(new ModInt(i));
        }
        invFact[max] = fact[max].inv();
        for (int i = max; i >= 1; i--) {
            invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i].mul(new ModInt(i));
        }
    }

    static ModInt C(int x, int y) {
        if (y < 0 || y > x) return new ModInt(0);
        return fact[x].mul(invFact[y]).mul(invFact[x - y]);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int md = sc.nextInt();
        ModInt.MOD = md;

        precomputeFactorials(m);

        ModInt[] ptr_ways = new ModInt[m + 1];
        ModInt[] ptr_dp = new ModInt[m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            ptr_ways[i] = new ModInt(0);
            ptr_dp[i] = new ModInt(0);
        }
        ptr_ways[0] = new ModInt(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                // ptr_ways update
                ModInt term = ptr_ways[l].mul(ptr_ways[r]).mul(C(l + r, l)).mul(new ModInt(l + r + 2));
                ptr_ways[i] = ptr_ways[i].add(term);
                // ptr_dp update
                ModInt add = new ModInt(l).mul(new ModInt(l + 1)).add(new ModInt(r).mul(new ModInt(r + 1))).mul(new ModInt(2).inv());
                ptr_dp[i] = ptr_dp[i].add(ptr_ways[l].mul(ptr_ways[r]).mul(C(l + r, l)).mul(add));
                ptr_dp[i] = ptr_dp[i].add((ptr_dp[l].mul(ptr_ways[r]).add(ptr_dp[r].mul(ptr_ways[l]))).mul(C(l + r, r)).mul(new ModInt(l + r + 2)));
            }
        }

        ModInt[][] dp = new ModInt[n + 1][m + 1];
        ModInt[][] ways = new ModInt[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
                ways[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
            }
        }
        ways[0][0] = new ModInt(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int sMax = Math.min(m, i);
            for (int s = 0; s <= sMax; s++) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp[i][s] = ptr_dp[s];
                    ways[i][s] = ptr_ways[s];
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s + 1; d++) {
                    int add = d - 1;
                    ModInt ft = dp[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    ModInt way = ways[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    ways[i][s] = ways[i][s].add(way.mul(ptr_ways[add]).mul(C(s, add)));
                    dp[i][s] = dp[i][s].add((way.mul(ptr_dp[add]).add(ptr_ways[add].mul(ft))).mul(C(s, add)));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[n][m]);
    }
}
